component.name: Rivulet
component.summary: Modern screen recording and streaming software

description.p: Rivulet is a modern screen recording and streaming application that runs entirely on the desktop and does not require an account. Record gameplay, your screen, or stream to services such as Twitch and YouTube.
Recordings are stored locally in open formats (WebM/MKV) using hardware-accelerated encoding on NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs.
